BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION

      IN THE MATTER OF SOUTHWESTERN                                     )

      FOR: (1) REVISION OF ITS RETAIL RATES                             )   Docket 25-00079-UT
      UNDER ADVICE NOTICE 341; AND (2) OTHER                            )
      ASSOCIATED RELIEF                                                 )


               ORDER GRANTING MOTION TO FILE TESTIMONY IN SUPPORT
                           OF STIPULATION OUT OF TIME

          THIS MATTER comes before the Keven Gedko and Patrick Schaefer, hearing

examiners for the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission (“Commission”), upon a Motion

to File Testimony in Support of Stipulation Out of Time (“Motion”) filed by Coalition for Clean

Affordable Energy (“CCAE”) on July 1, 2026.1 Being duly informed, the hearing examiners

FIND and CONCLUDE:

          1.       The Order Revising Procedural Deadlines, filed on June 18, 2026, set June 22,

    2026, as the deadline for filing of a comprehensive stipulation and June 30, 2026, as the deadline

    for filing testimony in support of a contested stipulation.2

          2.       On June 22, 2026, Southwestern Public Service (“SPS”), New Mexico Department

    of Justice (“NMDOJ”), New Mexico Large Customer Group (“NMLCG”), Occidental Permian

    Ltd. (“OPL”), Louisiana Energy Services (“LES”), Federal Executive Agencies (“FEA”), Targa

    Resources Corp., Walmart Inc., Coalition for Clean Affordable Energy (“CCAE”), and Prosperity

    Works (collectively, “Signatories”) filed a Comprehensive Stipulation.3

          3.       On July 1, 2026, CCAE filed the present Motion, requesting a one-day extension

    to July 2, 2026, to submit the Testimony in Support of Stipulation, stating the prior deadline was



1
    Motion to File Testimony in Support of Stipulation Out of Time (July 1, 2026).
2
    Order Revising Procedural Deadlines (June 18, 2026) at 3, ¶G.
3
    Comprehensive Stipulation (June 30, 2026).
            BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION
Order Granting Motion                                Docket No. 25-00079-UT


inadvertently missed. CCAE sought the positions of the other parties prior to filing its Motion

and represented that none objected.

        4.     The extension requested is effectively a two-day extension through July 2, 2026.

        5.     Granting the Motion will not delay the proceeding or prejudice any party.

IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED:

        The Motion is GRANTED. CCAE shall file testimony in support of stipulation by July 2,

2026.


        ISSUED under the Seal of the Commission at Santa Fe, New Mexico, on July 2, 2026.


                 NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION
